verdicts.reason: A reflows the design into a left-to-right banner, and the headline and orange CTA are legible. But the plan cards are out of sequence (6, 80, 48 instead of monthly, yearly, family), the card labels, subtitle and fine print are illegibly small, and the left cluster is cramped. B just shrinks the original portrait layout into the middle of the banner and leaves large empty areas on both sides. All of B's text, including the headline, prices and CTA, is unreadable, so B is unusable.
